activate.title: Activate your account
activate.body: If you were invited to the staff console and have not activated your account yet, you can do it here. It needs the authenticator code you signed in with.
activate.confirmBody: This activates your own account. Nobody else, an administrator included, can do it for you.
activate.notDone: Your account was not activated. Contact your administrator.
activate.refused: This account cannot be activated here. Contact your administrator.

consent.withdrawnDone: Your consent was withdrawn. You can grant it again at any time.
